action.action-desc: Ms. Boebert introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs

form.official-title: To direct the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to furnish inpatient treatment under the Veterans Community Care Program for a mental health condition, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Veterans’ Mental Health Access Act.

section.header: Furnishing of inpatient treatment for a mental health condition under the Veterans Community Care Program

subsection.text: The Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall furnish covered care to a covered veteran.

The Secretary shall furnish covered care under subsection (a) not later than 24 hours after the covered veteran requests covered care or a health care provider prescribes covered care to the covered veteran.
Every six months, the Secretary shall publish on a website of the Department of Veterans Affairs a report regarding the wait time for a veteran seeking covered care furnished—

paragraph.text: in a medical center of the Department of Veterans Affairs; or
under the Veterans Community Care Program.
The term covered care means inpatient treatment for a mental health condition, including post-traumatic stress disorder, depression, or substance abuse, furnished—

subparagraph.text: in a medical center of the Department of Veterans Affairs; or
under the Veterans Community Care Program.

paragraph.text: The term covered facility means, with respect to a covered veteran, the medical center or hospital of the Department of Veterans Affairs—

subparagraph.text: that is closest to the residence of the covered veteran; and
where the Secretary furnishes covered care sought by the covered veteran.

paragraph.text: The term covered veteran means a veteran described in section 1703(b) of title 38, United States Code.
The term Veterans Community Care Program means the program established by section 1703(a) of title 38, United States Code.
